capabilities: Render navigable period headers and inline calendars in journal notes
Create and link daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly notes from filename dates
Auto-fill new journal notes from per-tier template notes
Roll up, categorize, and migrate markdown tasks across journal notes
Bind icons to tags as left-margin signifiers
extras: Documents known visual issues (fold arrows and editor line numbers overlapping margin signifiers) and detailed interop guidance for coexisting with the Tasks plugin and task-styling themes.
motivation: The author wanted a journaling setup that assumes nothing about where journals live or how many you keep, instead of a single global daily-notes folder.
problem: Most journaling plugins assume one global daily-notes folder, so users keeping several independent journals in different folders have no per-folder navigation, calendar, or settings.

relations.evidence: The Obsidian Tasks plugin shares the same checkbox alphabet; keep task-interaction-scope on lists
Templater with Folder Templates is the cleanest way to inject the journal-header block automatically

summary: Folder-based journaling plugin that turns any vault folder into a multi-tier journal with navigable headers, calendar pickers, and task rollups.
